en.page_title: Claude Paper — One paper, two lights
en.description: A paper-inspired Orca workspace: warm light and charcoal dark, coordinated Chat and agent terminals, and {icon_count} original file icons.
en.lead: Warm Paper and Warm Night. Chat, coding agents, files and diffs in one considered workspace.
en.subline: Warm Paper · Warm Night · Paper Fold icons
en.provenance: Captured in an isolated public demo profile. Every scene is a complete native Orca interface; the agent scene shows two genuine CLI panes in one workspace. No private chats, account details or personal project names.
en.details_title: From the first question to the last line.
en.details_intro: One visual language for the places you move through every day.
en.chat_body: 73 app color tokens cover chat, sidebars, tabs, code and diffs. Paper tones separate surfaces; terracotta marks actions; blue highlights links and chat selections.
en.icons_body: {icon_count} original SVGs and {mapping_count} mappings distinguish documents, code, tests and tools. {folder_count} folder categories include both closed and expanded states.
en.terminal_title: Keep the terminal in the picture.
en.terminal_body: Warm Paper and Warm Night for coding agents, with matching Codex syntax themes and an optional IBM Plex Mono font. Claude Code can also follow the palette through Orca’s theme sync.
en.folders_intro: {folder_name_count} common folder names are grouped by purpose, including skills, plugins, source code, data and output. Existing graphify aliases remain compatible; no particular project layout is required.
en.folder_limit: Every folder uses the same honey-kraft color, whatever its name. Open and closed states still show where you are.
en.example_body: The public date-kit example uses native Intl.DateTimeFormat, with no dependencies. English and Chinese guides explain the same behavior and commands.
en.example_prompt: Let formatDate use the local time zone by default, while keeping an explicit time-zone argument. Add tests around midnight.
en.example_note: The same instant can have a different calendar date in another time zone. Omitting the second argument uses the runtime's local zone.
en.install_summary: 2 app themes · 2 terminal palettes · Paper Fold icons · Optional font
en.store_install: Install from the Orca community store
en.copy_error: Could not copy automatically. Select and copy the command manually.
en.step_two_body: Select Claude Paper · 暖纸 (Warm Paper) for the light app theme and Claude Paper · 暖夜 (Warm Night) for dark. Choose the matching terminal palettes and Claude Paper · 纸折图标 for file icons.
en.step_three: 03 / CHAT: APP COLORS OR TERMINAL COLORS
en.step_three_body: For the Chat colors shown here, keep Match Terminal Appearance off. Turn it on if you prefer chat in your terminal font; chat then uses Claude Paper’s terminal colors.
en.step_optional_body: In Settings → Appearance, search “Claude Code” and enable Match Claude Code to Terminal Theme. It follows the terminal palette, including outside Orca. Turning it off restores the previous Claude Code theme; choosing a theme inside Claude Code stops the sync. This plugin does not enable it automatically.
en.requirements: Requires Orca 1.4.255+. IBM Plex Mono is optional; choose it in the terminal or editor font picker. Layout stays native.
en.scope_intro: App colors, file icons and optional fonts through public interfaces. No runtime entry point or extra capability permissions.
en.unofficial: Unofficial community theme. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or Stably.

en.codex_body: For matching code blocks and diff syntax, install the two companion themes, then choose claude-paper-light or claude-paper-dark with /theme in Codex CLI. This is a separate opt-in step.
en.font_body: IBM Plex Mono adds a quiet, readable monospace option for code and terminals. It is bundled under the SIL Open Font License; Chinese characters use system fallback fonts.

en.specimen_note: Actual 16 / 20 px marks · {extension_count} suffixes + {filename_count} exact filenames

en.claude_body: Claude Code: optionally enable Match Claude Code to Terminal Theme in Orca Appearance settings. This host setting also affects Claude Code outside Orca; choosing another theme in Claude Code stops the sync.

zh.page_title: Claude Paper — 一张纸，两种光
zh.description: 为 Orca 添一层纸质感：暖纸浅色、炭灰深色，协调的对话与智能体终端，以及 {icon_count} 个原创文件图标。
zh.lead: 暖纸与暖夜，把对话、智能体终端、文件和差异视图，放在同一张舒服的工作台上。
zh.subline: 暖纸 · 暖夜 · 纸折图标
zh.provenance: 使用独立公开演示配置实拍。每个场景均为完整 Orca 原生界面；智能体场景是在同一工作区内运行的两个真实 CLI 分屏。图片不含个人聊天、账户信息或私人项目名称。
zh.details_title: 从提问，到最后一行输出。
zh.details_intro: 为日常编程里的每一处切换，准备同一份温度。
zh.chat_body: 73 个应用色彩令牌，覆盖聊天、侧栏、标签、代码与差异。中性纸色区分层次，陶土强调动作，蓝色标记链接与聊天选区。
zh.icons_body: {icon_count} 个原创 SVG、{mapping_count} 条映射，区分文档、代码、测试与工具。{folder_count} 类常用目录均配有关闭与展开状态。
zh.terminal_title: 把终端放进同一幅画面。
zh.terminal_body: 为编码智能体准备暖纸与暖夜色板，附 Codex 语法主题与可选 IBM Plex Mono 字体。Claude Code 还可通过 Orca 的主题同步采用同一套配色。
zh.folders_intro: 按用途整理 {folder_name_count} 个常用目录名称，涵盖技能、插件、源码、数据和输出。保留 graphify 等既有别名兼容，不要求采用特定项目结构。
zh.folder_limit: 所有文件夹统一牛皮纸金棕色，不受命名影响；开合状态保留，方便辨认当前位置。
zh.folder_details: 查看全部支持的目录名称
zh.folder_table_caption: 目录用途与精确匹配名称
zh.exact_names: 匹配名称（不区分大小写）
zh.example_title: 同一个任务，中英两种表达。
zh.example_body: 公开 date-kit 示例使用原生 Intl.DateTimeFormat，无需额外依赖。中英文指南说明相同的行为和运行命令。
zh.example_prompt: 让 formatDate 默认使用本地时区，同时保留显式时区参数，并补充跨午夜的测试。
zh.example_note: 同一时刻在不同时区可能属于不同日期。省略第二个参数时，使用运行环境的本地时区。
zh.install_summary: 2 款应用主题 · 2 套终端色板 · 纸折图标 · 可选字体
zh.store_install: 从 Orca 社区商店安装
zh.copy_error: 无法自动复制，请选中安装命令手动复制。
zh.step_two_body: 应用浅色主题选择「Claude Paper · 暖纸」，深色选择「Claude Paper · 暖夜」；终端选择同名配色，文件图标主题选择「Claude Paper · 纸折图标」。
zh.step_three: 03 / 聊天跟随应用，或匹配终端
zh.step_three_body: 想要本页展示的对话配色，请关闭「匹配终端外观」；如果更希望对话使用终端字体，可以打开，此时对话采用 Claude Paper 终端配色。
zh.step_optional_body: 在「设置 → 外观」搜索 Claude Code，开启 Match Claude Code to Terminal Theme。Claude Code 会跟随终端色板，在 Orca 外也生效。关闭后恢复原主题；在 Claude Code 内选其他主题会停止同步。插件不会自动开启此选项。
zh.requirements: 需要 Orca 1.4.255+。IBM Plex Mono 为可选字体，可在终端或编辑器字体列表中选择；保留原生布局。
zh.scope_title: 熟悉的 Orca，更连贯的观感。
zh.scope_intro: 通过公开接口提供应用颜色、文件图标与可选字体。无运行入口，无额外能力权限。
zh.unofficial: 非官方社区主题，与 Anthropic 或 Stably 无隶属或背书关系。
